rules.title: Allowable Annual Rent Increase
rules.requirement: The allowable annual rent increase is 1.6% for the period from March 1, 2026 to February 28, 2027.

coverage.summary: Covered units under the San Francisco Rent Ordinance.

rules.title: Security Deposit Interest Rate
rules.requirement: The required interest rate on security deposits is 4.2% for the period from March 1, 2026 to February 28, 2027.

coverage.summary: Covered residential security deposits in San Francisco.

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition, Permanent Removal, Capital Improvements, or Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.requirement: For evictions based on owner/relative move-in, demolition, permanent removal of unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation, the relocation amount due per tenant is $8,245.00, with a maximum of $24,733.00 per unit, plus an additional $5,497.00 for each elderly or disabled tenant or household with minor children, for notices served between March 1, 2026 and February 28, 2027.
rules.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant up to $24,733.00 per unit

coverage.summary: Covered tenancies subject to San Francisco Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Ellis Act Evictions
rules.requirement: For tenants evicted under the Ellis Act, the relocation amount due per tenant is $11,110.05, with a maximum of $33,330.13 per unit, plus an additional $7,443.90 for each elderly or disabled tenant, for notices served between March 1, 2026 and February 28, 2027.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant up to $33,330.13 per unit

coverage.summary: Covered tenancies subject to San Francisco Rent Ordinance Section 37.9A.
